mapper.select: SELECT * FROM AGENT_TURN WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AGENT_TURN (id, thread_id, submission_id, submission_metadata_json, status, trigger_type, goal, step_count, llm_call_count, max_steps, max_llm_calls, final_response, failure_message, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{threadId}, #{submissionId}, #{submissionMetadataJson}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{goal}, #{stepCount}, #{llmCallCount}, #{maxSteps}, #{maxLlmCalls}, #{finalResponse}, #{failureMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM AGENT_TURN WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
